name: AI infrastructure capex reversal (hypothetical)
description: Hyperscalers cut data-centre spending: semiconductors, hardware, electrical equipment and power utilities reprice; crowded momentum winners unwind; value outperforms; a mild flight to Treasuries. Assets not named move with their factor betas.

name: 2020-style liquidity shock (replay)
description: Actual returns for February-March 2020. Monthly data understate the intra-month fall (the S&P 500 lost 34% from 19 February to 23 March); run on daily data to see it.

name: Credit crisis (hypothetical)
description: Equities fall 40%, financials 55%; quality holds up; Treasuries rally about 10% (10-year yield roughly -120 bp). Factor moves map to assets through betas estimated on the last ten years.

name: Dot-com bust (replay)
description: Actual returns September 2000 - September 2002: technology lost about 80% while bonds rallied.

name: 2008-style credit crisis (replay)
description: Actual returns from September 2008 (Lehman) to February 2009, weights held fixed.

name: 2022-style inflation and rate shock (replay)
description: Actual returns January-October 2022: stocks and bonds fell together as the 10-year yield rose from 1.5% to 4.1%.

name: Bond sell-off (+150 bp, hypothetical)
description: The 10-year yield rises about 150 bp (roughly -11% on a 10-year note), equities fall 8% and long-duration growth stocks lag value.

name: Sudden volatility spike (hypothetical)
description: Volatilities jump 2.5x and correlations move halfway toward 0.8 (diversification shrinks); equities fall 10% and Treasuries rally 3%. Reports one-month VaR and ES under the stressed covariance.
